blocks.zh: 導論：FDA 背書信函、前言與第一章
blocks.en: Introduction: FDA Endorsement Letter, Foreword and Chapter 1

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 了解 FDA 背書信函的歷史意義，以及 ISPE Baseline Guide 系列與 FDA 之間的合作關係
blocks.en: Understand the historical significance of the FDA endorsement letter and the collaboration between the ISPE Baseline Guide series and the FDA

blocks.zh: 理解 Baseline Guide 系列的誕生背景——產業為何需要一套統一的工程設計標準
blocks.en: Understand why the Baseline Guide series came about: why industry needed a unified set of engineering design standards

blocks.zh: 掌握本指引的適用範圍（Scope）：新建與翻新的製藥水系統與蒸汽系統
blocks.en: Grasp the Scope of this Guide: new and renovated pharmaceutical water and steam systems

blocks.zh: 認識四大關鍵概念：水質定義方法論、Critical Process Parameters（關鍵製程參數）、Good Engineering Practice（優良工程實務）、Design Options（設計選項）
blocks.en: Become familiar with the four key concepts: the water quality definition methodology, Critical Process Parameters, Good Engineering Practice, and Design Options

blocks.zh: 熟悉全書結構（Chapters 1-10 + Appendix），建立整體學習地圖
blocks.en: Get to know the structure of the whole Guide (Chapters 1-10 + Appendix) and build an overall learning map

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: FDA Letter（FDA 背書信函）
blocks.en: FDA Letter

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FDA 背書的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: What FDA Endorsement Means

blocks.zh: 這封信由 FDA CDER 主任 Janet Woodcock 與法規事務副局長 Dennis Baker 共同署名。在製藥界，這等於是最高層級的「認可」信號。
blocks.en: This letter was co-signed by Janet Woodcock, Director of FDA CDER, and Dennis Baker, Associate Commissioner for Regulatory Affairs. In the pharmaceutical world, this is a top-level signal of "recognition."

blocks.zh: 但請注意關鍵句：「This Guide is solely created and owned by ISPE. It is not an FDA regulation.」——ISPE 指引不是法規，遵循它不代表自動合規，不遵循它也不代表違規。
blocks.en: But note the key sentence: "This Guide is solely created and owned by ISPE. It is not an FDA regulation." An ISPE guide is not a regulation. Following it does not mean automatic compliance, and not following it does not mean a violation.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：米其林指南 vs. 食安法規
blocks.en: Analogy: The Michelin Guide vs. Food Safety Law

blocks.zh: ISPE Baseline Guide 之於 FDA 法規，就像「米其林指南」之於「食品安全衛生管理法」。米其林指南告訴你怎麼做出好餐廳（最佳實踐），但真正的法律義務來自食安法規。
blocks.en: The ISPE Baseline Guide is to FDA regulations what the "Michelin Guide" is to the "Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation." The Michelin Guide tells you how to run a great restaurant (best practice), but the real legal obligations come from the food safety law.

blocks.zh: FDA 的態度是：「我們看過這份指南，覺得很好，但最終你要對合規負責。」
blocks.en: FDA's attitude is: "We have reviewed this Guide and think it is good, but in the end you are responsible for compliance."

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務重點
blocks.en: Practical Points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 在客戶稽核或 FDA 查廠時，如果稽核員問：「你的水系統設計依據什麼標準？」你可以回答：「我們參考 ISPE Baseline Guide Volume 4，並依據 cGMP 21 CFR 211 確保合規。」
blocks.en: During a customer audit or FDA inspection, if the auditor asks, "What standard is your water system design based on?", you can answer: "We referenced ISPE Baseline Guide Volume 4 and ensure compliance under cGMP 21 CFR 211."

blocks.zh: 重點是——ISPE 指引是「最佳實踐」參考，不是「合規盾牌」。
blocks.en: The key point: an ISPE guide is a "best practice" reference, not a "compliance shield."

blocks.zh: 歷史脈絡：2000 年的產業背景
blocks.en: Historical Context: The Industry Background in 2000

blocks.zh: 這封信寫於 2000 年 10 月——當時製藥業面臨的問題是：
blocks.en: The letter was written in October 2000. The problems facing the pharmaceutical industry at the time were:

blocks.zh: 各公司對法規要求的解讀不一致，導致「軍備競賽」式的過度設計
blocks.en: Companies interpreted regulatory requirements inconsistently, leading to "arms race" style over-design

blocks.zh: 新設施成本不斷飆升，上市時間延長
blocks.en: The cost of new facilities kept soaring, and time to market grew longer

blocks.zh: FDA 也期望看到統一的工程標準，減少查廠爭議
blocks.en: The FDA also hoped to see unified engineering standards to reduce inspection disputes

blocks.zh: 這正是 Baseline Guide 系列誕生的根本原因。
blocks.en: This is exactly why the Baseline Guide series was born.

blocks.zh: Foreword（前言）
blocks.en: Foreword

blocks.zh: Baseline Guide 系列的誕生故事
blocks.en: The Story Behind the Baseline Guide Series

blocks.zh: 1994 年 5 月，製藥產業工程師代表與 ISPE 和 FDA 坐下來談了一件事：「能不能制定一套大家都認可的工程設計標準？」
blocks.en: In May 1994, representatives of pharmaceutical industry engineers sat down with ISPE and the FDA to discuss one question: "Can we develop a set of engineering design standards that everyone accepts?"

blocks.zh: 結果就是 9 本 Baseline Guide 的出版計畫：
blocks.en: The result was a publication plan for 9 Baseline Guides:

blocks.zh: Vol.1 - Bulk Pharmaceutical Chemicals（1996 年）
blocks.en: Vol.1 - Bulk Pharmaceutical Chemicals (1996)

blocks.zh: Vol.2 - Oral Solid Dosage Forms（1998 年）
blocks.en: Vol.2 - Oral Solid Dosage Forms (1998)

blocks.zh: Vol.3 - Sterile Manufacturing Facilities（1999 年）
blocks.en: Vol.3 - Sterile Manufacturing Facilities (1999)

blocks.zh: Vol.4 - Water and Steam Systems（2001 年）← 本書
blocks.en: Vol.4 - Water and Steam Systems (2001) <- this Guide

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：房屋建築規範
blocks.en: Analogy: Building Codes for a House

blocks.zh: 想像你要蓋一棟房子。建築法規（= cGMP）規定「房子不能倒」，但沒有告訴你管線怎麼走、用什麼材料最好。於是建築師公會出版了一本「最佳施工指南」（= Baseline Guide），讓大家有個一致的參考。
blocks.en: Imagine you are building a house. The building code (= cGMP) says "the house must not collapse," but it does not tell you how to run the pipework or which materials are best. So the architects' association publishes a "best construction guide" (= Baseline Guide) so that everyone has a consistent reference.

blocks.zh: 在 Baseline Guide 出現之前，每家藥廠各自解讀法規，結果就是「別人做了，我也要做，而且要做得更多」的一種「one-upmanship（互相加碼）」心態。
blocks.en: Before the Baseline Guides existed, each pharmaceutical company interpreted the regulations on its own, resulting in a "one-upmanship" mentality: "If others did it, I must do it too, and do even more."

blocks.zh: 關鍵提醒：Appendix 沒有 FDA 背書
blocks.en: Key Reminder: The Appendix Is Not FDA-Endorsed

blocks.zh: 前言明確指出：Appendix（附錄）未經 FDA 審閱，因此不具備 FDA 背書。
blocks.en: The Foreword states clearly that the Appendix was not reviewed by the FDA and therefore does not carry FDA endorsement.

blocks.zh: 這在實務中很重要——如果你在稽核時引用附錄內容作為設計依據，對方可能會說：「那只是參考資訊，不代表 FDA 認可。」建議將附錄內容視為工程參考，但核心設計依據仍以正文章節為主。
blocks.en: This matters in practice. If you cite Appendix content as a design basis during an audit, the other side may say, "That is only reference information and does not mean FDA recognition." We recommend treating the Appendix as an engineering reference, while the core design basis remains the main chapters.

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境思考
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: 你是一家 CDMO 的工程主管，正在為新廠設計水系統。客戶要求「符合 ISPE Baseline Guide」。你應該如何回應？
blocks.en: You are the engineering head of a CDMO designing the water system for a new facility. The customer requires "compliance with the ISPE Baseline Guide." How should you respond?

blocks.zh: 首先確認：ISPE 指引是最佳實踐參考，不是合規標準
blocks.en: First confirm: the ISPE guide is a best-practice reference, not a compliance standard

blocks.zh: 與客戶討論：實際合規標準是 21 CFR 211 和 USP 專論
blocks.en: Discuss with the customer: the actual compliance standards are 21 CFR 211 and the USP monographs

blocks.zh: 以 ISPE 指引作為設計框架，但所有關鍵決策都要有 cGMP 法規依據
blocks.en: Use the ISPE guide as the design framework, but every critical decision must have a cGMP regulatory basis

blocks.zh: 記住：過度設計（over-engineering）本身就是 Baseline Guide 要解決的問題
blocks.en: Remember: over-engineering is itself the problem the Baseline Guide set out to solve

blocks.zh: Acknowledgements（誌謝）
blocks.en: Acknowledgements

blocks.zh: 為什麼要看誌謝？
blocks.en: Why Read the Acknowledgements?

blocks.zh: 看誌謝頁不只是禮貌——它告訴你這份文件的「基因」：
blocks.en: Reading the acknowledgements page is more than politeness. It tells you the "DNA" of this document:

blocks.zh: 作者組成：Core Team 來自 Bristol-Myers Squibb、CRB（工程顧問）、Kvaerner（工程承包）、Kinetics（設備供應商）——涵蓋業主、設計、建造、設備四個關鍵角色
blocks.en: Author composition: The Core Team came from Bristol-Myers Squibb, CRB (engineering consultant), Kvaerner (engineering contractor) and Kinetics (equipment supplier), covering four key roles: owner, design, construction and equipment

blocks.zh: FDA 審閱團隊：6 位 FDA 官員參與審閱，包括 CDER 合規辦公室的 Richard Friedman——這在後來成為 FDA 水系統查廠的關鍵人物
blocks.en: FDA review team: Six FDA officials took part in the review, including Richard Friedman of the CDER Office of Compliance, who later became a key figure in FDA water system inspections

blocks.zh: 資金贊助：13 家大型藥廠出資，包括 Merck、Pfizer、Eli Lilly、BMS 等
blocks.en: Funding sponsors: 13 large pharmaceutical companies provided funding, including Merck, Pfizer, Eli Lilly and BMS

blocks.zh: 產業合作模式
blocks.en: The Industry Collaboration Model

blocks.zh: 這種「競爭對手坐在一起寫標準」的模式，在製藥業很常見。想像 Toyota、Honda、BMW 的工程師一起寫「汽車引擎最佳實踐指南」——他們在市場上競爭，但在安全標準上合作。
blocks.en: This model of "competitors sitting down together to write a standard" is common in the pharmaceutical industry. Imagine engineers from Toyota, Honda and BMW writing a "best practice guide for car engines" together: they compete in the market, but cooperate on safety standards.

blocks.zh: 製藥業的水系統就是這樣：每家藥廠都有自己的水系統，但大家需要一致的設計基準。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical water systems are the same: every company has its own water system, but everyone needs a consistent design baseline.

blocks.zh: 注意到 CRB 在多個章節都有參與。CRB 是北美頂尖的製藥工程顧問公司之一，至今仍然活躍。如果你的 CDMO 需要找外部工程顧問設計水系統，CRB 是業界首選之一。
blocks.en: Note that CRB took part in several chapters. CRB is one of the leading pharmaceutical engineering consulting firms in North America and is still active today. If your CDMO needs an external engineering consultant to design a water system, CRB is one of the industry's top choices.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Background（背景）
blocks.en: 1.1 Background

blocks.zh: Water System = 製藥工廠的「血管系統」
blocks.en: The Water System = The "Circulatory System" of a Pharmaceutical Plant

blocks.zh: 在無菌製造（Aseptic Manufacturing）環境中，水系統的重要性怎麼強調都不過分：
blocks.en: In an aseptic manufacturing environment, the importance of the water system cannot be overstated:

blocks.zh: WFI（Water for Injection，注射用水）是最終產品的直接成分
blocks.en: WFI (Water for Injection) is a direct component of the final product

blocks.zh: Purified Water（純化水）用於設備清洗、配液
blocks.en: Purified Water is used for equipment cleaning and compounding

blocks.zh: Clean Steam（純蒸汽）用於設備滅菌（SIP）
blocks.en: Clean Steam is used for equipment sterilization (SIP)

blocks.zh: 如果水系統出問題，整個生產線都要停機。這就是為什麼 ISPE 把水系統獨立成一本 Baseline Guide。
blocks.en: If the water system has a problem, the entire production line must shut down. This is why ISPE made water systems their own Baseline Guide.

blocks.zh: 成本問題的根源
blocks.en: The Root of the Cost Problem

blocks.zh: 想像你要買一台車。如果規格書只說「要安全」，有人會買 Toyota Corolla，有人會買裝甲車。差別可以是 10 倍。
blocks.en: Imagine buying a car. If the specification only says "must be safe," some people will buy a Toyota Corolla and others will buy an armored vehicle. The difference can be 10 times.

blocks.zh: 製藥水系統也是如此——當法規只說「要符合 cGMP」而沒有明確的工程標準時，保守的工程師就會選擇「裝甲車」方案。Baseline Guide 的目標就是告訴你：「Toyota Corolla 就夠了，而且這裡有具體規格。」
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical water systems are the same: when the regulation only says "comply with cGMP" and gives no clear engineering standard, conservative engineers choose the "armored vehicle" option. The goal of the Baseline Guide is to tell you: "A Toyota Corolla is enough, and here are the specifics."

blocks.zh: 注意用語：「Validation (Commissioning and Qualification)」
blocks.en: Note the Wording: "Validation (Commissioning and Qualification)"

blocks.zh: 原文用了括號把 commissioning and qualification 放在 validation 後面。這在 2001 年是新觀念——驗證不只是 IQ/OQ/PQ，還包括試車（commissioning）。
blocks.en: The original text places commissioning and qualification in parentheses after validation. This was a new idea in 2001: validation is not just IQ/OQ/PQ but also includes commissioning.

blocks.zh: 後來 ISPE Vol.5（Commissioning and Qualification）專門針對這個主題出版了完整指引。
blocks.en: ISPE later published a full guide dedicated to this topic, Vol.5 (Commissioning and Qualification).

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope of This Guide（本指引範圍）
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope of This Guide

blocks.zh: 與其他 Baseline Guide 的分工
blocks.en: Division of Labor with Other Baseline Guides

blocks.zh: 這裡明確提到驗證（validation）部分「不在本指引範圍」，而是由 ISPE Vol.5（Commissioning and Qualification Baseline Guide）負責。這代表你在規劃水系統專案時，至少需要同時參考兩本指引：
blocks.en: The Guide states explicitly that the validation portion is "outside the scope of this Guide" and is covered by ISPE Vol.5 (Commissioning and Qualification Baseline Guide). This means that when planning a water system project you need to refer to at least two guides at the same time:

blocks.zh: Vol.4：水系統怎麼設計、建造、運維
blocks.en: Vol.4: how to design, build, operate and maintain the water system

blocks.zh: Vol.5：水系統怎麼驗證（C&Q）
blocks.en: Vol.5: how to validate the water system (C&Q)

blocks.zh: US-centric 的歷史限制
blocks.en: The Historical US-centric Limitation

blocks.zh: 2001 年出版時，歐洲藥典（EP）和美國藥典（USP）對 WFI 的製備方式有根本性差異——歐洲只允許蒸餾法，美國則允許 RO（逆滲透）。這份指引以美國觀點為主，所以使用時要注意你的目標市場。
blocks.en: When it was published in 2001, the European Pharmacopoeia (EP) and the United States Pharmacopeia (USP) differed fundamentally on how WFI could be produced: Europe allowed distillation only, while the US also allowed RO (reverse osmosis). This Guide takes a mainly US perspective, so be aware of your target market when using it.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時供應歐美市場，需要額外參考歐洲藥典要求。（注：2017 年後歐洲藥典已修訂允許非蒸餾法製備 WFI。）
blocks.en: If your CDMO supplies both the European and US markets, you need to refer additionally to European Pharmacopoeia requirements. (Note: since 2017 the European Pharmacopoeia has been revised to allow non-distillation methods for producing WFI.)

blocks.zh: 範圍界定三要素
blocks.en: Three Elements of the Scope

blocks.zh: 本指引的範圍可以用三個「是」和三個「不是」來理解：
blocks.en: The scope of this Guide can be understood as three "yes" items and three "no" items:

blocks.zh: 1.3 Applicable FDA Regulations and Guides（適用法規與指引）
blocks.en: 1.3 Applicable FDA Regulations and Guides

blocks.zh: 法規層級解析
blocks.en: Analysis of the Regulatory Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 這四項法規文件形成了一個層級結構，你需要理解它們的關係：
blocks.en: These four regulatory documents form a hierarchy, and you need to understand how they relate:

blocks.zh: FD&C Act（聯邦食品藥物化妝品法）：最高層級的法律，授權 FDA 監管藥品製造
blocks.en: FD&C Act (Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act): the highest-level law, which authorizes the FDA to regulate drug manufacturing

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 211：cGMP 法規，第 211.48 條專門規範「水處理系統」
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 211: the cGMP regulations; Section 211.48 specifically governs "water treatment systems"

blocks.zh: USP（美國藥典）：定義各種水質的規格標準（WFI、Purified Water 等的化學和微生物指標）
blocks.en: USP (United States Pharmacopeia): defines the specification standards for each water quality (the chemical and microbiological attributes of WFI, Purified Water, etc.)

blocks.zh: FDA Inspection Guide：告訴稽核員「查廠時要看什麼」——這對你的 CDMO 最直接相關
blocks.en: FDA Inspection Guide: tells inspectors "what to look at during an inspection," which is the most directly relevant to your CDMO

blocks.zh: USP XXIV 的時代背景
blocks.en: The Time Context of USP XXIV

blocks.zh: 原文引用的是 USP XXIV（第 24 版，2000 年）。截至目前，USP 已更新到更新版本，水質專論（如 <1231> Water for Pharmaceutical Purposes）已有重大修訂。
blocks.en: The original text cites USP XXIV (the 24th edition, 2000). USP has since been updated to later editions, and the water monographs (such as <1231> Water for Pharmaceutical Purposes) have been significantly revised.

blocks.zh: 讀這份指引時，水質規格部分請務必交叉比對最新版 USP。
blocks.en: When reading this Guide, always cross-check the water quality specifications against the latest edition of USP.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Review Exercise

blocks.zh: 如果 FDA 稽核員問你：「你的 WFI 系統 TOC 上限是多少？依據什麼？」你應該引用哪一份文件？
blocks.en: If an FDA inspector asks you, "What is the TOC limit of your WFI system, and what is it based on?", which document should you cite?

blocks.zh: 提示：USP 藥典專論定義了 WFI 的化學規格（包括 TOC），而不是 Baseline Guide。ISPE 指引教你如何設計系統來達到這些規格，但規格本身來自 USP。
blocks.en: Hint: The USP monograph defines the chemical specifications of WFI (including TOC), not the Baseline Guide. The ISPE guide teaches you how to design a system to meet these specifications, but the specifications themselves come from USP.

blocks.zh: 1.4 Key Concepts（關鍵概念）
blocks.en: 1.4 Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念 (a)：水質規格決定一切
blocks.en: Key Concept (a): Water Quality Specification Determines Everything

blocks.zh: 這是整本指引最重要的一句話：
blocks.en: This is the most important sentence in the whole Guide:

blocks.zh: 「水質規格的制定，對系統全生命週期成本的影響，遠大於任何後續設計決策。」
blocks.en: "The way water quality specifications are set has a far greater impact on the total life cycle cost of the system than any subsequent design decision."

blocks.zh: 翻譯成白話：在設計水系統之前，你必須先回答一個根本問題——「我需要什麼品質的水？」回答錯了，後面所有設計都是白費。
blocks.en: In plain language: before designing a water system, you must first answer one fundamental question: "What quality of water do I need?" If you get that wrong, all the design work that follows is wasted.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：買屋前先確認需求
blocks.en: Analogy: Confirm Your Needs Before Buying a House

blocks.zh: 就像買房子——如果你一開始定義「我需要一棟能住 10 個人的透天厝」，但其實你只需要兩房公寓，那你後面再怎麼精打細算裝潢費，都救不回最初的決策錯誤。
blocks.en: It is like buying a house. If you define at the start, "I need a detached house that sleeps 10 people," when in fact a two-bedroom apartment is all you need, then no amount of careful budgeting on the renovation can rescue the original wrong decision.

blocks.zh: 製藥水系統也一樣：如果製程只需要 Purified Water（純化水），但你規格卻開成 WFI（注射用水），建置成本可能差 2-5 倍。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical water systems are the same: if the process only needs Purified Water but you specify WFI, the construction cost can differ by a factor of 2-5.

blocks.zh: Critical Instruments（關鍵儀器）
blocks.en: Critical Instruments

blocks.zh: 測量 CPP 的儀器就是 Critical Instruments。它們需要：
blocks.en: Instruments that measure CPPs are Critical Instruments. They require:

blocks.zh: 定期校正（Calibration）
blocks.en: Regular calibration

blocks.zh: 有校正追溯紀錄
blocks.en: Calibration traceability records

blocks.zh: 設定 Alert Limit（警戒限值）和 Action Limit（行動限值）
blocks.en: Alert Limits and Action Limits to be set

blocks.zh: 這個概念會在 Chapter 9（Instrumentation and Control）深入討論。
blocks.en: This concept is discussed in depth in Chapter 9 (Instrumentation and Control).

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念 (c)：Good Engineering Practice（優良工程實務，GEP）
blocks.en: Key Concept (c): Good Engineering Practice (GEP)

blocks.zh: GEP 的核心理念是「documented only once（只記錄一次）」。
blocks.en: The core idea of GEP is "documented only once."

blocks.zh: 在傳統做法中，工程團隊做試車文件、QA 團隊又做驗證文件，很多測試重複做了兩遍。GEP 的思維是：讓所有利害關係人從一開始就參與，用同一套文件完成試車和驗證。
blocks.en: In the traditional approach, the engineering team produces commissioning documents and then the QA team produces validation documents, so many tests are performed twice. The GEP mindset is to involve all stakeholders from the start and use one set of documents to complete both commissioning and validation.

blocks.zh: GEP 的精髓
blocks.en: The Essence of GEP

blocks.zh: 想像你裝修房子，如果水電師傅、室內設計師、使用者（你）各做各的，最後驗收時才發現問題，返工成本很高。GEP 就是要求這三方從設計階段就坐在同一張桌子上討論。
blocks.en: Imagine renovating a house. If the plumber and electrician, the interior designer and the user (you) each work separately and problems are only found at final acceptance, the cost of rework is high. GEP asks these three parties to sit at the same table from the design stage.

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念 (d)：Design Options（設計選項）
blocks.en: Key Concept (d): Design Options

blocks.zh: 本指引的核心哲學：不只有一種正確答案。同一種水質規格，可以有多種設計方案（RO + EDI、RO + 蒸餾、雙道 RO 等），各有優缺點。
blocks.en: The core philosophy of this Guide: there is more than one right answer. The same water quality specification can be met by several design solutions (RO + EDI, RO + distillation, double-pass RO, etc.), each with its own advantages and disadvantages.

blocks.zh: 指引提供「building blocks（積木式模組）」讓你根據實際條件組合，而不是一刀切的「標準方案」。
blocks.en: The Guide provides "building blocks" that you combine according to actual conditions, rather than a one-size-fits-all "standard solution."

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 承接了一個新客戶，產品是口服液體劑型（Oral Liquid Dosage Form）。客戶要求使用 WFI 作為配液水。你覺得有必要嗎？
blocks.en: Your CDMO takes on a new customer whose product is an Oral Liquid Dosage Form. The customer requires WFI as the compounding water. Do you think this is necessary?

blocks.zh: 口服產品通常只需要 Purified Water，不需要 WFI
blocks.en: Oral products usually need only Purified Water, not WFI

blocks.zh: 但有些客戶為了「安全起見」會要求更高等級
blocks.en: But some customers ask for a higher grade "to be safe"

blocks.zh: 你的角色是提供專業建議：解釋 Purified Water 已符合法規要求，並分析使用 WFI 的額外成本
blocks.en: Your role is to provide professional advice: explain that Purified Water already meets the regulatory requirements, and analyze the additional cost of using WFI

blocks.zh: 最終決策需要 QA 和客戶共同確認，但「過度規格」是你應該主動識別的風險
blocks.en: The final decision needs to be confirmed jointly by QA and the customer, but "over-specification" is a risk you should proactively identify

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念 (b)：Critical Process Parameters（關鍵製程參數）
blocks.en: Key Concept (b): Critical Process Parameters

blocks.zh: CPP 的定義：直接影響產品品質的參數。在水系統中，常見的 CPP 包括：
blocks.en: Definition of CPP: parameters that directly affect product quality. Common CPPs in water systems include:

blocks.zh: 注意原文的重要提示：微生物品質無法即時監控（培養需要 48-72 小時），所以控制微生物生長的「間接參數」（溫度、UV、臭氧等）就成為 CPP。
blocks.en: Note the important point in the original text: microbial quality cannot be monitored in real time (culture takes 48-72 hours), so the "indirect parameters" that control microbial growth (temperature, UV, ozone, etc.) become CPPs.

blocks.zh: 1.5 Guide Structure（指引結構）
blocks.en: 1.5 Guide Structure

blocks.zh: 學習地圖：全書結構解讀
blocks.en: Learning Map: Understanding the Structure of the Whole Guide

blocks.zh: 這 10 章 + 附錄的排列順序不是隨意的，它反映了一個水系統專案的決策流程：
blocks.en: The order of these 10 chapters + Appendix is not arbitrary. It reflects the decision flow of a water system project:

blocks.zh: Ch.1-2：先搞清楚基本概念和設計哲學
blocks.en: Ch.1-2: First understand the basic concepts and design philosophy

blocks.zh: Ch.3：決定「我需要什麼品質的水」→ 規劃系統架構
blocks.en: Ch.3: Decide "what quality of water do I need?" and plan the system architecture

blocks.zh: Ch.4-6：選擇水處理技術（從前處理到最終處理）
blocks.en: Ch.4-6: Select water treatment technologies (from pretreatment to final treatment)

blocks.zh: Ch.7：蒸汽系統（獨立但互相關聯）
blocks.en: Ch.7: Steam systems (independent but interrelated)

blocks.zh: Ch.8：水怎麼存儲和輸送到使用點
blocks.en: Ch.8: How water is stored and distributed to the points of use

blocks.zh: Ch.9：用什麼儀器監控系統
blocks.en: Ch.9: What instruments are used to monitor the system

blocks.zh: Ch.10：系統完成後怎麼驗證
blocks.en: Ch.10: How to validate the system once it is complete

blocks.zh: Ch.11-12：補充技術細節
blocks.en: Ch.11-12: Supplementary technical details

blocks.zh: 水系統的「生命旅程」
blocks.en: The "Life Journey" of Water Systems

blocks.zh: 把這個結構想像成水在你的工廠裡的旅程：
blocks.en: Think of this structure as the journey of water through your plant:

blocks.zh: 自來水進廠（Ch.4 前處理）→ 深度處理（Ch.5/6 最終處理）→ 儲存配送（Ch.8）→ 使用點
blocks.en: City water enters the plant (Ch.4 Pretreatment) -> Advanced treatment (Ch.5/6 Final treatment) -> Storage and distribution (Ch.8) -> Points of use

blocks.zh: 而 Ch.7 蒸汽是另一條平行路徑：原水 → 純蒸汽產生器 → 滅菌/加熱
blocks.en: Ch.7 Steam is another parallel path: Feed water -> Clean steam generator -> Sterilization/heating

blocks.zh: Ch.9 儀器控制則是全程的「神經系統」，監控每個環節的品質。
blocks.en: Ch.9 Instrumentation and Control is the "nervous system" throughout, monitoring the quality at every step.

blocks.zh: 重點提醒：先讀 Ch.2 和 Ch.3
blocks.en: Key Reminder: Read Ch.2 and Ch.3 First

blocks.zh: 如果你時間有限，建議優先閱讀順序：
blocks.en: If your time is limited, the suggested reading priority is:

blocks.zh: Chapter 2（Key Design Philosophies）——理解 Design Range vs. Operating Range 等核心概念
blocks.en: Chapter 2 (Key Design Philosophies): understand core concepts such as Design Range vs. Operating Range

blocks.zh: Chapter 3（Water Options and System Planning）——學會如何選擇正確的水質等級
blocks.en: Chapter 3 (Water Options and System Planning): learn how to choose the right water quality grade

blocks.zh: 然後根據你的實際需求選讀 Ch.4-8
blocks.en: Then read Ch.4-8 selectively according to your actual needs

blocks.zh: 不建議跳過 Ch.2 直接看技術章節，因為後續章節會大量引用 Ch.2 的概念框架。
blocks.en: Skipping Ch.2 and going straight to the technical chapters is not recommended, because later chapters refer heavily to the conceptual framework of Ch.2.

blocks.zh: 假設你是 CDMO 工程主管，現在要規劃一個新的無菌充填廠房的水系統。你需要：
blocks.en: Suppose you are the engineering head of a CDMO planning the water system for a new aseptic filling facility. You need:

blocks.zh: WFI 用於最終沖洗和配液
blocks.en: WFI for final rinse and compounding

blocks.zh: Purified Water 用於初步清洗
blocks.en: Purified Water for preliminary cleaning

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 用於 SIP
blocks.en: Clean Steam for SIP

blocks.zh: 試著對照章節結構，列出你需要重點參考哪幾章？為什麼？
blocks.en: Map this against the chapter structure: which chapters should you focus on, and why?

blocks.zh: 提示：你至少需要 Ch.3（規劃）、Ch.5（PW 處理）、Ch.6（WFI 處理）、Ch.7（蒸汽）、Ch.8（儲存配送）、Ch.9（儀器）。
blocks.en: Hint: You need at least Ch.3 (planning), Ch.5 (PW treatment), Ch.6 (WFI treatment), Ch.7 (steam), Ch.8 (storage and distribution) and Ch.9 (instrumentation).

blocks.zh: 本節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: FDA 背書的意義：ISPE Baseline Guide 是經 FDA 審閱的產業最佳實踐，但不是法規。合規最終依據是 cGMP（21 CFR 211）和 USP 藥典。
blocks.en: What FDA endorsement means: The ISPE Baseline Guide is industry best practice reviewed by the FDA, but it is not a regulation. The ultimate basis for compliance is cGMP (21 CFR 211) and the USP.

blocks.zh: Baseline Guide 誕生的根本原因：消除法規解讀的不一致性，避免「軍備競賽」式的過度設計，降低成本並加速上市。
blocks.en: Why the Baseline Guide came about: To eliminate inconsistent interpretation of regulations, avoid "arms race" style over-design, reduce cost and speed time to market.

blocks.zh: 範圍限定：本指引聚焦新建水/蒸汽系統的工程設計，以 US 法規為主；驗證部分請參考 ISPE Vol.5。
blocks.en: Defined scope: This Guide focuses on the engineering design of new water/steam systems, mainly under US regulations; for validation, refer to ISPE Vol.5.

blocks.zh: 四大關鍵概念：(a) 水質規格決定全生命週期成本；(b) Critical Process Parameters 是品質控制的核心；(c) GEP 強調「只記錄一次」和早期利害關係人參與；(d) 設計方案不只有一種正確答案。
blocks.en: Four key concepts: (a) the water quality specification determines life cycle cost; (b) Critical Process Parameters are the core of quality control; (c) GEP emphasizes "documented only once" and early stakeholder involvement; (d) there is more than one right design solution.

blocks.zh: 全書結構：10 章 + 附錄，依照水系統專案的邏輯決策流程排列，建議從 Ch.2 開始循序漸進。
blocks.en: Structure of the Guide: 10 chapters + Appendix, arranged in the logical decision flow of a water system project; we suggest starting from Ch.2 and proceeding step by step.

blocks.zh: CDMO 啟示：在承接客戶專案時，首要任務是與客戶和 QA 確認「真正需要的水質規格」，避免過度設計帶來的不必要成本。
blocks.en: Takeaway for CDMOs: When taking on a customer project, the first task is to confirm with the customer and QA the "water quality specification that is truly needed," to avoid unnecessary cost from over-design.
